name: Gorizia (Italy)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Gorizia (a white castle on blue within a yellow border) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Gorizia, a comune in Friuli Venezia Giulia; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Gorizia arms — white castle on blue within a yellow border, crowned, within branches
